meta.title: Items from 5 PRs show the first PR and the count of the rest
gaps: Tick one item from each of PR-8 through PR-12 and assign them to User A.
Log in as User A in a separate buyer session.
Verify the exact PR-8 number is always the oldest first PR and remains the same on repeated notifications.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Tick one item from each of PR-8 through PR-12 and assign them to User A.; Log in as User A in a separate buyer session.; Verify the exact PR-8 number is always the oldest first PR and remains the same on repeated notifications.

steps.note: Enable the required PR team filtering configuration before the test.

args.need: provide the PR manager and User A sessions, assign one item from each of PR-8 through PR-12 to User A, then leave the User A buyer portal ready

steps.note: The catalog has no step for assigning multiple PRs or logging in as another buyer.

args.goal: click the top-right bell icon and open the notifications panel, leaving the notification for the five assigned PRs visible

steps.note: Open the notification panel in User A's session.
Assert the notification identifies the assignment and includes a PR number.
Assert the notification aggregates the remaining four PRs.
